blocks.text: Samandaron mein tel ki pollution, khaas taur par jahazon se oil leaks (tel ka rasna) aur spills (tel girna) se, environment ke liye bara khatra hai. Jab tel ghalti se samandar mein gir jata hai to pani ki satah par tezi se phail kar ek tah (layer) bana leta hai jo dhoop rokti hai aur oxygen exchange (hawa aur pani mein oxygen ka len-den) kam karti hai. Is se machhliyon, parindon aur mammals samet marine life (samandari zindagi) ko sakht nuqsan hota hai. Samandari mammals apna jism saaf karte (grooming) hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain, aur hydrocarbons ke samne rehne se machhliyon ki sehat ko lamba nuqsan ho sakta hai. Tel ki pollution coastal habitats (sahil par jaandaron ke rehne ki jagahon), jaise mangroves, coral reefs aur beaches, ko bhi kharab karti hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki satah par tel ki kaali tah. Suraj ki roshni ka teer tah par ruk jata (laal X), aur O2 ka teer bhi pani mein dakhil nahi hota (laal X). Neeche pani mein machhli.
